description:
We are building an AI-driven decision-support platform for Field Shift that fuses NASA Earth observations (POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS) with local soil data to help farmers choose climate-resilient crop rotations.

Our Stack: Full-Stack Web (React, Python), Geospatial Analytics & AI/ML.

Looking for teammates skilled in: • Data Visualization & UI/UX Design • Earth Science / Agriculture Domain Knowledge • Storytelling & Pitching

Let’s build an impactful solution for Coimbatore!
